svg.title: On the clip's worst 5% of frames yah265 scores 2.0 VMAF v1 points higher
svg.desc: VMAF v1 per frame of a 90-second Tears of Steel clip at 1080p, for two encodes of the same size. The yah265 line sits above the x265 line through most of the low stretches.
svg.text: On the clip's worst 5% of frames yah265 scores 2.0 VMAF v1 points higher
a 90-second Tears of Steel clip at 1080p frame by frame, from two files of the same size.
